rv.q: These are beautifully wrought characters, and the actors, one and all, are superb.
Go see this play while it’s here!!
I know that I had a lot to think about on the drive home as well as while I started to write this.

cn.t: Critics find this Midwest premiere a solid showcase for The Village Theater's young talent, with the 90-minute one-act earning generally positive notices for its performances and staging at Rivendell Theatre Ensemble.
